question: v11
q: When does the CBD empty out on a Friday compared with midweek?

transcript.answer:
The Friday drop-off is at the 4pm to 6pm peak. Before 4pm Friday looks like a normal weekday, and after 8pm Friday is busier than midweek.

**Last 12 months, Sydney CBD, Friday vs the Tue-Thu average (tap-ons per hour):**

| Hour | Tue-Thu avg | Friday | Friday as % of Tue-Thu |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3pm | ~43,000 | ~41,100 | ~95% |
| 4pm | ~65,500 | ~51,900 | ~79% |
| 5pm | ~95,300 | ~64,600 | ~68% |
| 6pm | ~51,600 | ~40,800 | ~79% |
| 7pm | ~27,600 | ~25,200 | ~91% |
| 10pm | ~12,400 | ~19,600 | ~159% |
| 11pm | ~5,600 | ~11,300 | ~204% |

The 5pm peak is where Friday falls furthest behind, at about a third fewer tap-ons than a typical midweek evening.

**Overall ratio:** Friday's 3pm to 7pm tap-ons run at about 78% of the Tue-Thu average. The monthly figure has stayed in a narrow band, from 74% to 84%, since January 2024. The latest reading, September 2026, is 78.3%.

**Before COVID** (January to March 2020), the 5pm drop was smaller: Friday was about 85% of midweek at 5pm, against about 68% now. So the Friday exodus has become more pronounced since the pandemic.
